name: aid
description: AI Development Methodology: 6 phase gates from discovery to ship, 28 skills, 38 review sub-agents, and WHY-first enforcement hooks. Stops code being written before the problem is understood.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/aid_hooks.py" --event SessionStart; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/aid_hooks.py" --event SessionStart; fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/aid_hooks.py" --event PreToolUse --action phase_gate_write; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/aid_hooks.py" --event PreToolUse --action phase_gate_write; fi

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/aid_hooks.py" --event PreToolUse --action phase_gate_bash; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/aid_hooks.py" --event PreToolUse --action phase_gate_bash; fi

hooks.statusMessage: Initializing dev pipeline for approved plan...
